provenance.note: employment is Max's worked example. Other flairs drafted 2026-09-22. Article names aligned to Nolo breadcrumb areas on 2026-09-22. Contract uses Business Formation and Small Claims, where the contract articles actually sit. Digital and school have no Nolo area and are statutes only. Health Care Law and Elder Law were dropped because those areas do not exist. Prefixes omit the year root (for example '2025 New York Laws'). Paths are prefixes: a one-element path maps a whole code. California prefixes use official pubinfo TOC headings, including bracketed section ranges. The CCP unlawful-detainer prefix includes the PRELIMINARY PROVISIONS node between Part 3 and Title 3. New York prefixes use the Senate Open Legislation headings. Penal Article 156 includes Part 3 and Title J, which sit between the code and the article.
